name: InputOTP
description: A one-time code, a box a digit: confirming a phone inside an app. Persian digits typed or pasted are sent as Latin ones.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

length.description: How many boxes; six are drawn as two threes.

defaultValue.description: Starts with these digits; the merchant changes them.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

variant.description: secondary is for a field on a grey surface.

onComplete.description: Every box filled: the code, Latin.
